items.name: Lab sampling TDR (Tek 80E04 class)
items.source: Tektronix 80E04 datasheet: 250 mV into 50 ohm, 23 ps incident; ~400 uV RMS single-sweep noise typical

items.name: Fast lab sampling TDR (Tek 80E10B class)
items.source: Tektronix 80E10B datasheet: 250 mV, 12 ps incident; wider bandwidth, slightly higher noise than 80E04

items.name: Portable metallic TDR (Tek 1502C class)
items.source: Tektronix 1502C datasheet: 300 mV nominal into 50 ohm, 200 ps system; portable-class ~2 mV screen noise

items.name: Handheld cable tester
items.source: representative handheld class (datasheets specify pulse width, not rise time); coarse front end
